provenance.note: The sustained role, one event name for four families that `p.timbre` chooses between: the strings (the default, and MEASURED the biggest sustained family, 31% of 52 tracks: a fast-attack chord held long and drowned in reverb), the swell (the same body with the slow attack back, 4%), the organ (drawbars, which hold flatter through the bar than anything else, about one theme in ten) and the rhodes (a tine held rather than struck, the study's keys blend, 8%). The two strings families render through their own rows; the two keyboards are the keys' rows held — and so is any patch a note names, as the module handed any name to the keys.

notes.timbres: Timbre to row. `sustain` is a keyboard patch held rather than struck: the note crosses with `sustain` set, its `preset` the timbre, and its knobs re-expressed against the patch's own, so what crosses is the factor.
notes.controls: What a part may write on a sustained note, taken by every row it renders through. The entrance, the tail and the corner have no single default: they are the timbre's own (a swell's attack is not the strings'), so a note that does not say plays the timbre. `motion` scales the note's own drift, chorus and tremolo (1 is the room's), and `fadeCurve` is the raised-cosine envelope switch.
notes.knobs: The sustained role's ranges (PLAN-MODULATION M1), the pad's as they always were: every default is the strings family's own measured number — the 25 ms median attack, the 0.52 still sounding at the bar line, the 1.2 kHz corner that landed the centroid at 620 Hz — and what a knob moves is a factor on whichever sustained timbre is holding, including the keyboard patches the pad holds, which take it re-expressed against their own. A swell's own 0.55 s attack is a swell's; the knob makes it half again or a tenth of itself, and it is still a swell. The ceiling on brightness is well under the engine's limit for a measured reason: not one track in 52 closes a filter inside a note and 21% brighten, and five saws at a 6 kHz corner is a saw pad, which this instrument is written not to be. The grain (round SPARK-1) is a factor on the breath a place writes under the ensemble, one at the house; its measured slope is the pad alone under the house's breath against none, seeds 1 and 29 theme two, +0.004 and +0.007 LU (notes/rounds/spark-1.md).
